name: org.scoutee/scoutee
title: Scoutee
description: Tender search + AI CPV finder. Register free: 1 daily email alert(s), up to 20 results/search.

tools.name: search_public_tenders
tools.description: Find open tender previews by keyword, country or budget, without an account. Up to 10 results/page and 3 pages; country counts cover the same matches. Full notices require workspace MCP; alerts and analysis require the Scoutee app. Each search spends one of two anonymous queries/hour/IP, shared with CPV and the website. When an anonymous result has quota.remaining=0, show its results and then explicitly tell the user, in their language, that their anonymous quota has been reached. Show a clickable 'Create a free account' link to https://scoutee.org/en/signup as the next step to continue now. Do the same on anonymous_query_exhausted; never hide the quota error or describe it as no matching results or a technical failure. Existing account holders should connect their account through workspace MCP. Account quotas still apply; do not promise unlimited access. Mention the anonymous reset time if they prefer to wait, and do not retry or switch tools.

q.description: Free text over title, buyer and description. Every word must match the *start* of a word in the notice ('nettoy' finds 'nettoyage'); a substring inside a word does not match. Accent- and case-insensitive.
q.title: Q

keyword.description: Keywords matched as whole words (plural tolerated) in title, buyer or description, plus the cached translations of each keyword on the portals of that language — the way to search across countries without translating anything yourself. Several keywords widen the search (a notice matching any of them is returned).
keyword.title: Keyword

country.description: Countries of the publishing portal, by their English name as Scoutee stores it ('France', 'Germany', 'Italy'; 'Europe' for TED). Several countries add up. Omit to search everywhere — the `by_country` map of any result lists the exact values in use.
country.title: Country

min_value.description: Minimum estimated value, in the currency of the notice. Notices without a published value remain included when this is set.
min_value.title: Min Value

max_value.description: Maximum estimated value. Notices without a published value remain included.
max_value.title: Max Value

sort.description: 'newest' (publication descending, the default), 'oldest' (publication ascending) or 'deadline' (soonest submission deadline first).
sort.title: Sort

page.description: 1-based page number, 1 to 3 on this free endpoint.
page.title: Page

tools.name: get_public_tender
tools.description: The public page of one notice, by its Scoutee identifier (the `id` of a search result). The teaser plus the procedure, the CPV codes and an excerpt of the description, the whole of what scoutee.org shows an anonymous visitor. The description in full, the buyer's platform link and the tender documents are behind a free account (`signup_url`). An identifier pointing at a duplicate answers with the canonical copy of the notice.

tools.name: find_cpv_codes
tools.description: Find official EU CPV candidates for an activity, not a company name or URL. Returns up to 30 localized codes with hierarchy/provenance. Select and explain matches, then ask the user to confirm. No web research or paid AI call. Spends one of two anonymous queries/hour/IP shared with search and the website. When an anonymous result has quota.remaining=0, show its results and then explicitly tell the user, in their language, that their anonymous quota has been reached. Show a clickable 'Create a free account' link to https://scoutee.org/en/signup as the next step to continue now. Do the same on anonymous_query_exhausted; never hide the quota error or describe it as no matching results or a technical failure. Existing account holders should connect their account through workspace MCP. Account quotas still apply; do not promise unlimited access. Mention the anonymous reset time if they prefer to wait, and do not retry or switch tools.

activity.description: The actual products, works or services supplied. Use specific activity terms; never send private company data.
activity.title: Activity

locale.description: Official label language, such as en, fr or de; unavailable labels fall back to English.
locale.title: Locale
